### Error and Accuracy Calculation

**Given:**
- Expected (True) value, $V_{	ext{expected}} = 90\text{ V}$
- Measured value, $V_{	ext{measured}} = 88.5\text{ V}$

#### (i) Percentage Error ($%\text{Error}$)
$$\text{Absolute Error} = |V_{	ext{expected}} - V_{	ext{measured}}| = |90 - 88.5| = 1.5\text{ V}$$
$$\%\text{Error} = \left( \frac{\text{Absolute Error}}{V_{	ext{expected}}} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{1.5}{90} \right) \times 100 = 1.67\%$$

#### (ii) Relative Accuracy ($A$)
$$\text{Relative Accuracy} = 1 - \left| \frac{V_{	ext{expected}} - V_{	ext{measured}}}{V_{	ext{expected}}} \right| = 1 - \frac{1.5}{90} = 1 - 0.0167 = 0.9833 \text{ (or } 98.33\% \text{)}$$
proTip: Relative accuracy can also be directly found as $1 - \text{Relative Error}$.
